title: MONUMENT: MAY COMPANY GARAGE, HISTORIC-CULTURAL MONUMENT #1001
text:
MONUMENT: MAY COMPANY GARAGE, HISTORIC-CULTURAL MONUMENT #1001

  Plan Area: Downtown  Council District: 14 – Jurado

  PROPERTY ADDRESS:  900 – 914 South Hill Street; 216 – 224 West 9th Street

  Informational presentation on the proposed rehabilitation project for reuse of the building for self-service
  storage. Commission review and comment.

  Owner/Applicant:  900 S Hill LLC

  Presenters:  Darren Mehdizadeh, Markwood Enterprises; Taek Kim, Ware Malcomb; and
  Robert Chattel, Heritage Consulting Group
summary: Informational presentation on the proposed rehabilitation of the May Company Garage (Historic-Cultural Monument #1001) at 900-914 South Hill Street in Downtown for reuse as self-service storage.
